title: Listening practice
subtitle: Unit 14: Free time and simple plans

steps.title: Listen once
steps.body: In the real test you hear each recording once. Tap the speaker, listen, then choose. Do not replay. Never leave a question empty.

steps.question: What does the speaker like?
steps.explain: The speaker says jouer au hockey.

steps.fr: Tu veux aller au concert samedi ?
steps.question: What event is the invitation for?
steps.explain: The speaker invites someone to un concert.

steps.fr: Désolée, je ne peux pas vendredi. Je suis libre dimanche.
steps.question: When is the speaker free?
steps.explain: The speaker says je suis libre dimanche.

steps.question: Which activity does the speaker prefer?
steps.explain: The speaker says je préfère le patinage.

steps.fr: On va à la cabane à sucre dimanche à onze heures.
steps.question: When are they going to the sugar shack?
steps.explain: The speaker says dimanche à onze heures.
